title: SG-4.2.4 · Untrack the 15,329 tracked node_modules files via a tested cleanup script
summary: A verified, unit-tested cleanup removes every tracked node_modules path from the git index and keeps files on disk
description: Context: game/frontend still has 15,329 tracked files under node_modules (including phaser and its type-generation test files) plus the vitest results cache, which is currently an unmerged (UU) index entry. src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts already has trackedNodeModulesPaths, parseGitLsFiles, checkTrackedFiles and untrackNodeModules (git rm -r --cached), and scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts runs it through the npm script untrack:node-modules. Desired behavior: the cleanup verifies its own result, fails loudly if any path stays tracked, and reports counts, all covered by unit tests with a mocked git runner. Why: so the tracked dependency files can be removed reliably, and the guard run by npm test stays green.
acceptance_criteria: Given a git runner that lists tracked node_modules files, when the cleanup runs, then it issues git rm -r --cached and re-lists the index to confirm none remain
Given the index still lists a node_modules path after the rm, when the cleanup runs, then it throws naming the leftover paths
Given the CLI helper, when cleanup succeeds, then it logs the untracked count and returns exit code 0, and on failure it logs the error and returns 1
Given unit tests use a fake git runner, when they run, then no real git command executes and no file is deleted from disk

in_scope: src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts verified cleanup and CLI helper
unit tests with a fake git runner
out_of_scope: Changing the assertNoTrackedNodeModules guard or the test script
preserve: Existing untrackNodeModules behavior and its tests

technical_constraints: Use only git rm --cached, never delete working-tree files
Git access goes through the injected GitRunner type
definition_of_done: All acceptance criteria are covered by passing unit tests
non_functional: Cleanup tests run in seconds with no real git
